## New iPhone Models Are the First Apple Devices to Operate on Dedicated Anterix 900 MHz Private Networks


September 21, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.anterix.com/node/21446/pdf)


### iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo launch with Anterix 900 MHz connectivity, extending dedicated private wireless to one of the world’s most widely used device platforms


WOODLAND PARK, N.J., Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Anterix (NASDAQ: ATEX), the market leader in enabling mission-critical private wireless broadband networks, today announced that the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo are the first iPhone models to operate on dedicated private LTE networks using Anterix 900 MHz spectrum.


The new models bring iPhone connectivity to dedicated private wireless networks operating on band 106 licensed 900 MHz spectrum, giving critical infrastructure operators another device for field communications, operational applications, video, situational awareness and other mission-critical activities.


“When we started down this path, private wireless was a very different market,” said Carlos L’Abbate, Chief Technology and Engineering Officer of Anterix. “Today, an iPhone, which is used every day by millions of people, can now operate on the same private 900 MHz network infrastructure that supports mission-critical operations. It is another clear sign that dedicated private wireless networks are becoming mainstream communications platforms.”


Private wireless networks connect the people, equipment and applications that critical infrastructure operators rely on every day. With iPhone now supported on Anterix 900 MHz Band 106 networks, operators can incorporate a widely used mobile device into the same dedicated network infrastructure supporting specialized devices and operational systems across their environments.
